## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 402 captures during April 2019. The activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational variation is noted in the report.

The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below. Captures were reviewed for their suitability for grading, and the resulting outcomes were recorded for routine monitoring of site performance.

## Image quality

Of the 402 captures, 26 were ungradable. This gives an ungradable rate of 6.5%. These captures could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the gradable results. The image quality measure is included to support review of the site’s capture process and to identify the proportion requiring consideration outside the standard grading pathway.

## Grading

Grading identified 48 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7 days. Together, these figures summarise the grading activity associated with the April 2019 captures at West Gate Eye Clinic. They should be considered alongside the ungradable results when reviewing the overall site operation for the month.
